Downtown Northfield One-Bedroom - Heat Included!

This one-bed, one-bath, apartment is located in Downtown Northfield, Vermont. Start your morning with a coffee from one of Northfield’s great cafe’s and in the evening grab a bite or brew next door at Good Measure. This apartment features real hardwood flooring, large windows that fill the space with light, and is conveniently located around the corner from a laundromat (cards and coins accepted!) With folding door enclosure, you can close off the bedroom entirely for privacy when you need it - or leave it open for a breezy studio feel. The galley kitchen is off to the right, with tons of cabinet storage, refrigerator, and electric oven. The full bathroom is equipped with a bathtub and overhead shower. More than an apartment, this space offers you room to live, relax, and make it your own!

Resident responsible for electric (Northfield Electric) and cable/wifi (if desired)

We love animals, however only service animals and emotional support animals allowed with approval. Vet records required. Dogs must be met prior to approval.
